items.title: Richard Brunies Interview, 1959-04-27
items.q: Rap Polar, George Applernish, and Rag Baby Stevens. He's there. And Rap Polar's there, too.

ctx.x: You mean Nick LaRocca and his bunch. Played ragtime.

No, ragtime. We slept in the niggas. The niggas, they don't play no jazz. They don't play jazz. There was then five men that originated jazz. They really, they really. Now, the whole other. Rap Polar, George Applernish, and Rag Baby Stevens. He's there. And Rap Polar's there, too. And Paul Moreau's there, too. And Paul Moreau. Yeah, that's right. And Chink Martin. And bass.
There are a couple of other trumpet players. I was going to ask some names I don't know about. George Barth. Do you remember? Oh, Barth.
